rows.inventory_scope: Google Ads, YouTube, Display & Video 360 and Authorized Buyers subject to the linked policy and inventory-specific restrictions.

rows.age_targeting: Sportsbook and casino ads may not target users under 21; DFS may not target users under 18.
rows.creative_rules: Legal-state disclosure, adult eligibility and promotion terms must be clear; DFS cannot imply school or university affiliation.
rows.responsible_gambling: Sportsbook and casino creative or landing pages must include addiction warning and assistance information; DFS requires problem-gambling information.
